project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings
question: For the historical requirements relevant to the current client task, reconstruct their last valid state immediately before the current task. Do not apply the current task to that state.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Marisol, the signature block still reads “licensed professional's name.” Please replace that placeholder with the full legal name. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Kieran, I couldn't see any attached file. Please resend it so I can provide an accurate quote.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I'm reviewing it now; once that's done, I'll get back to you in a few minutes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What estimated timeframe and budget are you considering? I can provide support with stamping your project.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My proposal is a turnaround of 6 business days for the review and stamp, at a fee of \$320, because the project change is very simple. Please let me know. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Although the project is simple, the document runs 84 pages, so the earlier quote might be too low. Could we set the fee at $640-800 and complete it within the next 72-96 hours?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Kieran, I wanted to check: have you remained available?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Even though 84 pages may seem daunting, you really do not need to review all of them. I initially felt the same way, but the actual work is limited to reviewing the minor modifications listed in the word file. For this change, I am a licensed mechanical engineer, and my scope comes down to only the highlighted portion of the attached file. The electrical scope is similarly limited. If \$480 works for you, let’s finalize it at that amount and I will inform the client. Please advise.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, let's move forward.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before we can begin the work, please send a contract.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will inform the client of our agreement. Once I receive confirmation, I will initiate the offer. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For the attached project, the required deliverables are permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp; I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamps. Would you be available to support this additional work, and if so, what price and timeline would you quote?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I can provide support for that project as well.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What budget do you have in mind?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could you propose a reasonable price? I will then check with the client to see whether it fits his budget.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: When is the project expected to be ready to kick off? For the fee, I propose $750.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Can the provided description file explaining what changed be used as the basis for stamping, or does the client need to supply redline drawings?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Because it shows what was done in response to the previous comment, I consider a redlined drawing the best file to stamp.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I'll ask the client again. Just to confirm, this includes permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all necessary load calculations, correct? T 24 is not needed, but HvAC sizing calculations are required. Could you also provide your California electrical PE license number? The project should kick off soon, no later than five weeks from now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Given that I understood the scope to cover only review and stamping, could you clarify whether I am also expected to provide additional drawings and calculations?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Would pictures of the changes that align with the written description be sufficient? If you still require redlines, I will request them; I just want to determine the minimum documentation needed to kick off the project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For kickoff, the minimum documentation I would typically require consists of the written scope of work, which has already been provided; photos of every modified area; the room numbers associated with each change; and any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups showing the approximate locations of the work.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The electrical PE is MERCER T DANIEL, and the license number is 47283.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: To clarify the scope, you would create and stamp the electrical drawings, while I would stamp the mechanical drawings. You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings; please confirm that this is within your competence. The applicable scope includes Manual. J, Manual S, and Manual D.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For this clarified scope, what price would you propose? Also, what timeline would you propose?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This clarified scope is within my capabilities. Assuming the architectural background files are complete and permit-ready, my estimate for the electrical permit drawings, PE stamp, required electrical calculations, and applicable Manual J/S/D calculations is $12,000–$18,000, with an approximate turnaround of 7–9 weeks. The scope is extensive.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: That estimate seems high, so I am curious whether you have completed projects of a similar size and whether clients typically pay this much. I am asking because I do not want to accept a job that is too large to deliver, while also wanting to quote a price that is not completely outside the market range. Thanks for your help, Marisol.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Your pricing is not outside the market, since fees in that range are fairly typical when calculations, permit drawings, and PE stamping are included. Projects of similar size and complexity are within my experience. The important part is being comfortable with the scope and confident that you can support the project through permitting.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Once the client responds, I'll pass their feedback along. First, I'll present this pricing to them. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My Pleasure

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Kieran, could you let me know whether the project remains available?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Marisol, I've contacted the client. Their response is what I'm currently waiting for.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood. Your response is what I'll be waiting for as well.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I'll keep you informed once I have an update.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Great

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you let me know, Kieran, whether the client has provided an update?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Marisol, the client's latest response says that a formal offer is being sent, the electrical redlines are still outstanding, and the pictures have been received. I have not received the formal offer yet and am waiting for it. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Does this update mean that we are still involved in the project, and what does it mean for us?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will contact you if the client responds. Given how slow he has been to reply, however, I would not rely on that; he may still contact me after receiving the redline. Thank you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Marisol, I hope you are doing well. The client contacted me to ask whether you can stamp the changes without redlines, possibly by adding a letter describing the change you are approving. Is that feasible? If it is, I can send you the formal offer. Please also resend the PE name and license number, because I am seeing different information for Nevada PE license 47283 on the PE website. Thanks, Kieran.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, that stamping and letter approach is feasible. Thanks for getting back to me.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you write the letter so that I can stamp it together with the other materials?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For clarity, I was not the person who sent license # 47283.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: We will use MERRICK NOLAN's electrical PE license 038617 to stamp your project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Since the scope now includes a stamped letter, would it be possible to increase the budget to $620?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For easy reference, I’ve reattached the word file containing the changes, Marisol. Thanks.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Since the PE stamp was included from the outset, could we cap the amount at \$540?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please submit the formal offer.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For confirmation, could you please send the plan again?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’ve attached it; please let me know if you have any questions.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Some pages already show a stamp. For clarity, which pages should receive the electrical stamp?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Before this project’s changes, the as-built drawings were captured in the .pdf copy. The project’s electrical revisions appear in the word file you are reviewing and approving so the as-built electrical sheets can be amended.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Whichever option is more convenient, you may either add a cover letter and stamp the word file, or redline the existing pdf and stamp those marked-up sheets to confirm your concurrence with the changes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I think the better option is to prepare a cover letter stating that the work is done and stamp the word file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: To verify that the completed work matches what is specified in the word file, I’ve asked the client to provide pictures of the changes.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Correct

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright—I will update you soon.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Greetings, Kieran.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hello there, Marisol.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The project has been completed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: When will the second milestone be activated? I wanted to check.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Once the client accepts the delivery, I’ll complete the second milestone. I retained it to incorporate any client or city comments if the stamped method is rejected or they request changes to the confirmation method.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although I conservatively set the date as Oct 14, I do not expect it to take that long.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood. After I deliver the stamped word document, you can approve the first milestone and activate the second. You won’t release payment for the second milestone until you have provided confirmation, so this sequence protects both of us.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before I have this letter stamped, please review it and identify any corrections needed in the wording.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’ll review it and get back to you. The quick turnaround is appreciated, Marisol—thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: my pleasure

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: So that you can activate the second milestone, please release payment for the letter and stamped note.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Because I’m currently traveling and not at a computer, I’ll review it as soon as I have an opportunity and then release the payment as well.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: okay

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: During a stop in my travels, Marisol, I was able to review the letter. It looks good, but the PE stamp is missing; could you please sign it and return it to me?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For the item referenced here, could you please apply the stamp? Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes—once you release the first payment and activate the second milestone, I’ll provide the stamped letter.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: i will send without delay

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The payment has now been released—perfect, thank you.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The second milestone still hasn’t been activated. Activating it would show me that I’m waiting for your confirmation with the city.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Kieran, are you there? Hello?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I stepped away for a few minutes—sorry. It should be active now; is it showing as active for you? Please confirm.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Attached is the letter with its stamp.

requirement_summaries.REQ_NEVADA_PE_IDENTITY_AND_ATTRIBUTION: Correct Nevada Electrical PE Identity and Attribution

review_notes: Every scoring leaf received an explicit reviewed comparator status.
